title: Remember a valid session after browser close
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Use a persistent opaque session cookie and server validation. Handle negotiated lifetimes and process restart per the agreed policy. Bind the host to the correct installation.

**Verify** · Actually close and reopen the same browser profile. Check valid, expired and revoked sessions and isolation across two loopback installations, including changed ports.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-055, WI-061

**Queue** · Follows WI-061 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
